Sol.1.(c) Malevolent having or showing a wish to do evil to others. Benevolent well meaning and kindly. Kind -having or showing  a  friendly, generous, and considerate nature. Generous showing  a readiness to give more  of  something,  especially  money, than is necessary or expected. Compassionate -feeling or showing sympathy and concern for others.
Sol.2.(c)  Frail  (of  a  person)  weak  and delicate. Potentate a person with great power. Puissant  one  who  wields  great  power or sway. Sovereign a supreme ruler, especially a monarch. Monarch  a  sovereign  head  of  state, especially a king, queen, or emperor.
Sol.3.(b) Exasperate - to irritate intensely. Placate -  to make (someone) less angry or hostile. Appease - to pacify or placate (someone) by acceding to their demands. Pacify -  to  quell  the  anger,  agitation,  or excitement of. Conciliate -to stop (someone)  from
being angry or discontented.
items.contextualized_text:
Solutions :-
Sol.1.(c) Malevolent having or showing a wish to do evil to others. Benevolent well meaning and kindly. Kind -having or showing  a  friendly, generous, and considerate nature. Generous showing  a readiness to give more  of  something,  especially  money, than is necessary or expected. Compassionate -feeling or showing sympathy and concern for others.
Sol.2.(c)  Frail  (of  a  person)  weak  and delicate. Potentate a person with great power. Puissant  one  who  wields  great  power or sway. Sovereign a supreme ruler, especially a monarch. Monarch  a  sovereign  head  of  state, especially a king, queen, or emperor.
Sol.3.(b) Exasperate - to irritate intensely. Placate -  to make (someone) less angry or hostile. Appease - to pacify or placate (someone) by acceding to their demands. Pacify -  to  quell  the  anger,  agitation,  or excitement of. Conciliate -to stop (someone)  from
being angry or discontented.

items.text:
Sol.4.(b) Odorless - having no smell. Redolent -strongly smelling of something. Fragrant -  having  a  pleasant  or  sweet smell. Evocative -bringing strong images, memories, or feelings to mind. Pungent -  having  a  sharply  strong taste or smell.
Sol.5.(b) Permanent lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely. Fugacious tending to disappear. Vanishingdisappear suddenly and completely. Temporarylasting for only  a limited period of time. Transitory not permanent or lasting.
Sol.6.(a)  Philanthropist  a  person  who seeks  to  promote  the  welfare  of others, especially  by  the  generous  donation  of money to good causes. Misanthrope -a  person  who  dislikes humankind and avoids human society. Narcissist -a person who has an excessive  interest  in  or  admiration  of themselves. Cynic -a person who  believes that people are motivated purely by self -interest rather than acting for honourable or unselfish reasons. People-hater  a  person  who  dislikes humankind and avoids human society.

Sol.6.(a)  Philanthropist  a  person  who seeks  to  promote  the  welfare  of others, especially  by  the  generous  donation  of money to good causes. Misanthrope -a  person  who  dislikes humankind and avoids human society. Narcissist -a person who has an excessive  interest  in  or  admiration  of themselves. Cynic -a person who  believes that people are motivated purely by self -interest rather than acting for honourable or unselfish reasons. People-hater  a  person  who  dislikes humankind and avoids human society.

Sol.7.(b) Benign gentle and kind. Pernicious having a harmful effect. Deleterious causing harm or damage. Lachrymose given to weeping. Malignant malevolent.
Sol.8.(a)  Sincerity  the  quality of being honest or genuine. Duplicity deceitfulness. Guile sly or cunning intelligence. Cunning  having  or  showing  skill  in achieving one's ends by deceit or evasion. Artifice a clever or artful skill.
Sol.9.(b) Harsh  unpleasantly  rough  or jarring to the senses. Mellifluous (of a voice or words) sweet or musical. Smooth (of a sound) produced without friction; soft and even. Sweet (of a sound or smell) pleasing or fragrant. Flowing -moving smoothly and continuously.
Sol.10.(b)  Compliant -  willing  to  agree with others or obey rules.
Recalcitrant -having an obstinately uncooperative attitude toward authority
